messages.content: What is the shortest driving distance in miles from New York City to Los Angeles and then from Los Angeles to Miami, considering that you have to return to New York City from Miami?

function.name: get_shortest_driving_distance
function.description: Calculate the shortest driving distance between two locations. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

unit.description: Preferred unit of distance (optional, default is kilometers).

We need to calculate each segment's shortest driving distance in miles. We can use the tool get_shortest_driving_distance with origin/destination strings and specify unit as miles. We'll call it three times:

1) NYC -> LA
2) LA -> Miami
3) Miami -> NYC

Then sum them up or provide individual legs plus total.
